Historical 64-bit scalar boundary samples
Go 1.25.1; linux/amd64; Intel Xeon Platinum 8573C; GOMAXPROCS=1; default GC.
Captured under shared verification load. Timings are raw samples, not speedup evidence.
This preserves the pre-#271 Int64/Float64 default baseline; the user has approved
signed32/binary32 defaults, so do not treat these samples as the future public ABI.

Reproduce with scripts/bench-lowering -scalar-locals -count=1 -benchtime=100ms.
For an older compiler revision, copy the current bench-lowering fixture/driver
into that checkout without changing compiler/runtime code, then run the command.
Inputs: Int=1024, Float=1.25; forwarding iterates a 1024-item List[Int].
Payload cases receive preboxed Result.ok inputs; parse_* returns that Result.
Checking, building and process startup are excluded from each benchmark loop.
The parity test also checks Result error propagation and Float rounding/IEEE cases.
Samples are informational; tests do not assert noisy timing thresholds.
